verses.1: And these are the kings of the earth who conquered the children of Israel and took possession of their land, across the Jordan from the east side of the sun, from the river Arnon to Mount Hermon. And all the surrounding areas were also under their rule.
verses.2: Shishun, the king of the Amorites, ruled over a territory that stretched from the banks of the Arnon River, along the river itself, up to half of Gilad, and as far as the source of the river. This territory was the boundary between the children of Ammon and others.
verses.3: And from the east, there are seas of salt; and from the east, there’s also the sea of salt. These seas extend all the way to Beth Yishmoath. And from there, they continue under Ashdoth Pisgah.
verses.4: And the king of the Baashanites was defeated by the doctors who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
verses.5: And from Mount Hermon, and in Salkha, and throughout all the Bashan region, up to the borders of Geshuri and Ma’akhati, and half of Gilad. The border is Sichon, ruled by Heshbon.
verses.6: Moses, the servant of Jehovah, and the children of Israel were also given land. Moses gave this land to Reuben, Gad, and half of the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.7: And these were the kings of the land whom Joshua and the Israelites defeated across the Jordan River. They ruled from the valley of the Lebanon to the upper part of Mount Seir. Joshua gave them these lands as a heritage for the Israelites, just as they had been given by their ancestors.
verses.8: In the mountains, in the deserts, in the wildernesses, in the forests, on the coasts, and on the Hittite, Canaanite, Philistine, and Babylonian lands.
verses.9: One king of Jericho, one of the kings who ruled from the side of the Temple.
verses.10: One king of Jerusalem, one of the kings of Hebron.
verses.11: One king of Jeramo, one king of Lakish.
verses.12: One king from Egypt, one of the kings of Gezer.
verses.13: One king among the kings of Gideon.
verses.14: One king of Hарама, and one king of Arad.
verses.15: One king of Libnah was one of the kings of Edom.
verses.16: One king from Makkedah, one king from Bethel.
verses.17: One king from the tribe of Tafuchah, one king from the tribe of Hefer.
verses.18: One of the kings of Lasharon was a king named Melaq.
verses.19: One king of Madon, one of the kings of Khazor.
verses.20: King Shimeron was one of the kings of Achshaph.
verses.21: One king among the kings of Megiddo.
verses.22: One of the kings of Judah, a king from the tribe of Simeon, went to Jerusalem.
verses.23: A king of a kingdom is like one of the kings of other nations, who is insignificant in comparison.
verses.24: One king among all thirty-three kings.
